chunks: Tomorrow they will know who is the impudent liar!

key_terms.غَدًا: Tomorrow (referring to the Day of Judgment)

ai.seo_question: Who is the impudent liar mentioned in Surah Al-Qamar?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the ultimate vindication of the Ahl al-Bayt, where the 'impudent liar' (al-Kadhdhab al-Ashir) refers to those who opposed the Prophet's family and their divine authority. The phrase 'tomorrow' (ghadan) signifies the immediacy of the Day of Judgment, emphasizing that the transition from denial to certain knowledge will be sudden and undeniable for the disbelievers.
